caption: A warm-toned kitchen with wooden cabinets, granite countertops, and a central island. Sunlight streams through large windows, illuminating tiled floors and a dining nook with dark chairs. A ceiling fan rotates gently overhead. The camera follows a rolling chair in a long tracking shot, weaving through the kitchen, past the island, around the dining table, and toward the living room. The chair glides smoothly, revealing a cozy fireplace and staircase in the background.
